title: Check Out This Target Gift Card Hack
description: Finally, Cruze suggest something that kind of blew our minds. Did you know that Target will trade gift cards to other retailers for gift cards to Target? We didn't either! For more follow the hashtag #RachaelRayShow

asr.full_text: Target. So part of Target, what they do is so many gift cards that you have, not Target gift cards, other retailers, you just sit in your wallet, you forget about them. This happened last week, I went shopping at a store and I remembered after, oh I had a gift card for that, we forget! So Target takes many, many stores, you can trade in other stores gifts cards to Target. Are you kidding? And they will give you a Target gift card. They may take a small percentage, but if you're gonna use it, it's worth the money, worth the money. Yet another reason to love that dog with the red patch on his eye. That's it.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a television discussion of an ordinary Target gift-card exchange program for unwanted retailer gift cards. The speaker notes that a small percentage may be taken, while the visuals show an informational program segment and a webpage describing the exchange process rather than deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary retail gift-card exchange service described in the program discussion and shown on the displayed Target trade-in webpage.
